Please confirm when the address is updated!"]

Could you help me check which address it was sent to, the tracking number, and whether it’s still on the way? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered. And if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s, so I don’t have to change it every time I order something for her.", "I actually don’t remember my email address right now, but my name is Lucas Santos and my ZIP code is 80239.

I don’t have the order ID with me, but I placed the order about a week ago. The main thing I remember is that I ordered a tablet for my daughter—unfortunately, I can’t recall the brand or model off the top of my head. Maybe you can help me find it with my name and ZIP?

And for the address update, I’ll need to grab my daughter’s full address. Would you like me to give it to you now, or should we wait until we sort out the order details first?", "Thank you for checking all that for me. I’m glad to know the tablet is 64GB, that’s what I was hoping for. It’s strange that it says delivered, though—my daughter hasn’t mentioned getting anything yet. Maybe it’s sitting at her building’s front desk or something. I’ll have to ask her to check.

As for the address update, yes, I’d like to go ahead and make her place my default shipping address. Here’s her info:

- Address line 1: 943 Maple Drive
- Address line 2: Suite 356
- City: Chicago
- State: IL
- Country: USA
- ZIP code: 60621

Let me know if you need anything else from me. And, if you don’t mind, could you double-check if there’s any other order for her address that might still be in transit? Sometimes I forget what I’ve ordered, to be honest. It’s just me here in Denver, so I like to send her little surprises now and then. Keeps me busy, you know?", "Yes, please go ahead and make that my default shipping address.

Thank you for checking on the other orders too. I guess I must have only sent the tablet recently. I appreciate you helping me sort all this out—it’s nice to have someone to chat with, even if it’s just about packages. Sometimes it gets a bit quiet around here."]
